authorization: User requested continued execution of the saved research plan
scope: Development comparison of continuous and frozen Linear29 motor references on one supported shift and two known controller failures
selection_disclosure: Conditions chosen after reading the sibling 24-trial screen; this is a registered diagnostic follow-up, not a held-out test. Replaces the provisional six-case +/-5cm/shared-clear proposal before new native outcomes.
controls: Reuse the exact sibling tasks, scenes, checkpoints, seed 96161, public selector, full continuous bank and scoring; reuse existing decoded Linear29 banks byte-for-byte. Native callback unchanged.
stopping: Require offline parent reference/index replay and bindings before launch. Continuous must exactly reproduce the corresponding sibling physical trajectory, references and actions; task failure does not stop or exclude its Linear29 comparison. Within each method pair require exactly equal initial state/history/dynamics/RNG and initial selection costs. Infrastructure failure, resource timeout or qualification mismatch stops remaining launches, without retries.
analysis: Report all six scheduled outcomes, pairwise gains/regressions, contact/deadline failures, goal error and complete-task scores; independently recompute scores and references. Success-conditioned codec retention is separate from all-task support. No statistical equivalence or population inference.
cost_boundary: Continuous planner bank retained; same float640 motor interface. This study does not demonstrate end-to-end storage or communication savings.
limitations: One ancestry, one seed, three deliberately selected beam contexts, simulator localization, known map. No new clear trials, reset variation, deeper motion, responsive composer, learning, language or perception intervention. Farther goal changes authored floor geometry too; do not treat between-context physical differences as a goal-only intervention.
